module: credential vault, attachment readers and origin/IP policies

findings.title: Live saved-credential handles retain revoked destination domains
findings.scenario: A user narrows a vault login domain list while an issued 15-minute handle remains alive. Resolve reloads its current password but returns the old domain list, which browser_fill_secret passes directly to the secure browser. It can fill the password into a destination removed in settings.
findings.fix: Intersect the original approved domains with the current vault domains at resolution; refuse an empty intersection. Adding domains in settings cannot widen an already issued handle.
findings.reproduction: Real SQLite vault and encrypted miniredis handle: remove old.example.com and add new.example.com; original Resolve still returns old.example.com. Fixed Resolve returns only the still-approved example.com.

invariants_checked: Vault ownership is authenticated web-user-only, ciphertext bound to item/user, key-required encryption, secret-free prompt response, domain intersection and revocation.
Attachment inventory precedes document reads; bounded parse wait, per-image results, scoped cache keys, singleflight and VLM slots, projection failures remain warnings.
Embed origin normalization excludes userinfo/path/query/fragment/header injection and preserves explicit wildcard port behavior.
IP classifier covers private/link-local/reserved and mapped/translated IPv4 representations; policy remains caller-owned.
limitations: No live vault credentials, browser filling, Redis service or external site used.
Audit covers these library units and the fill-tool boundary; broader authentication/sandbox policies are separate pending units.
No actionable issue identified in attachment reader, embedpolicy or ipclass.
